predicted_errors.error_location: Section 3 (Iterative Step, quadrangular face case, main construction proof for Theorem 1.2)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text defines two distinct auxiliary edges inconsistently: "if there is an edge e2 = (vk+1, v2), where vk+1 ∈ Bxk+1 and v2 ∈ Bx3, we also connect xk+1 to x2. Similarly, if there is an edge e4 = (vk+1, v2), where vk+1 ∈ Bxk+1 and v2 ∈ Bx3, we also connect xk+1 to x2." Both e2 and e4 are defined identically (with v2 ∈ Bx3, connecting xk+1 to x2), which is inconsistent with the subsequent correct usage in the same proof, where e2 is explicitly tied to cycle C123/face x2 (via Bx2) and e4 is tied to cycle C143/face x4 (via Bx4) — e.g., "The second part is bounded by a cycle C143 ... If e4 does exist ... f14 = (x1, x4, xk+1) and f43 = (x4, x3, xk+1)." The earlier definitions of e2 and e4 therefore contradict their later usage, making the proof internally inconsistent as presented.
